runtime: Packaged Prism Launcher client on AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX
world: Copied disposable commands-enabled world on Normal difficulty
visual_verdict: Both models remain recognizable in every captured scene. The Ghost's face and silhouette remain clear; the Wraith retains its purple face, separated arms, particles, and silhouette in daylight, at night, in rain, and indoors.
